species: mouse (C57BL/6J cultured cells; C57BL6N and TRPA1 knockout mice in vivo)
readout_other: Fluo-4 AM calcium imaging; iGluSnFR glutamate imaging; whole-cell patch clamp; tail-movement score and latency; c-Fos immunohistochemistry; TUNEL
direction_notes: Ultrasound evoked astrocytic calcium rises and glutamate release with indirect neuronal calcium responses in vitro (blocked by TRPA1 antagonist), and tail movement and c-Fos increases in mouse motor cortex in vivo.
safety_notes: TUNEL-positive damage to neurons and astrocytes and bleeding traces were seen only at the 0.62 MPa (supra-watt) condition, not at 0.15 MPa.

exposures.label: Ultrasonocoverslip in vitro stimulation of cultured astrocytes and neuron-astrocyte coculture

target.label: cultured cortical astrocytes and neuron-astrocyte coculture

device.model: Ultrasonocoverslip (PVDF-TrFE transducer integrated on a glass coverslip)

timing.protocol_description: The fundamental pulse sequence used a train of 333 μs long 6 MHz bursts with PRF of 1.5 kHz; 'pulse length' (total sonication) was varied by changing the number of bursts, e.g. 750 bursts for a 500 ms transmission. Frequency was also varied from 5 to 10 MHz at 0.15 MPa and 0.5 s.

exposures.label: 750 kHz transcranial stimulation of mouse motor cortex (tail movement)

target.label: a motor cortical region ... to the best position where the tail movement was mostly elicited

device.model: custom-made 750 kHz PZT concave transducer (DL-61HD), 31 mm diameter, 23 mm focal distance

timing.protocol_description: Pulse length of 0.5 s at pressures between 0.07 and 0.62 MPa measured under a mouse skull piece; the acoustic parameters are given only in Fig. 6b, so PRF and duty cycle are not available in the text.
